messages.subject: Government Relations & Public Affairs Executive | ESG and Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Anna,

Mavence's specialist work across public policy, government relations and senior public-affairs leadership aligns directly with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where policy engagement, regulatory strategy and institutional trust are central to business execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
